[TPS_MANI_03669] Ethernet tunneling through CAN XL ⌈If an Ethernet connec- tion of a MachineDesign shall be realized by Ethernet frames tunneled through a CAN XL network, the EthernetCommunicationConnector aggregated by the Ma- chineDesign shall set the value of attribute category to CAN_XL and additionally have a reference in the role canXlProps to meta-class CanXlProps which contains the required CAN XL specific configuration parameters, i.e. CanControllerXlCon- figuration and CanControllerXlConfigurationRequirements.⌋ Class CanXlProps Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::AdaptivePlatform::SystemDesign Note This meta-class is used to configure Machine specific CAN XL attributes.
